boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus places for studying, meeting, dining, and taking a break, grounded in Southwestern’s library, dining, map, and student-life materials.

cards.title: Academic Commons
cards.subtitle: First floor, A. Frank Smith, Jr. Library Center
cards.notes: Use this first-floor library area when you want a livelier study setting. The library identifies it as a noisy, high-traffic space.
cards.short_summary: A social-energy study option inside Smith Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern lists Academic Commons among the first-floor noisy, high-traffic spaces in Smith Library Center.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms and Spaces | Southwestern University
cards.access_notes: Located in Smith Library Center; follow current library access rules.

cards.title: Melville Alcove
cards.subtitle: First floor, A. Frank Smith, Jr. Library Center
cards.notes: Settle into this named first-floor alcove for independent work when activity around you is welcome rather than distracting.
cards.short_summary: A named library alcove in the active first-floor zone.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern lists Melville Alcove as a first-floor noisy, high-traffic space in Smith Library Center.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms and Spaces | Southwestern University
cards.access_notes: Located in Smith Library Center; follow current library access rules.

cards.title: Writers Voice Alcove
cards.subtitle: First floor, A. Frank Smith, Jr. Library Center
cards.notes: Choose this named alcove for reading or drafting when you prefer a first-floor library space with some surrounding movement.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor named alcove for individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern lists Writers Voice Alcove among Smith Library Center’s first-floor noisy, high-traffic spaces.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms and Spaces | Southwestern University
cards.access_notes: Located in Smith Library Center; follow current library access rules.

cards.title: The Courtyard
cards.subtitle: First floor, A. Frank Smith, Jr. Library Center
cards.notes: Bring a book or laptop to this library courtyard when you need a quieter first-floor alternative to the commons and alcoves.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study option identified by the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern identifies The Courtyard as a quiet first-floor study space in Smith Library Center.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms and Spaces | Southwestern University
cards.access_notes: Located in Smith Library Center; follow current library access rules.

cards.title: Prothro Room
cards.subtitle: Second floor, A. Frank Smith, Jr. Library Center
cards.notes: Check whether the room is in use, then take advantage of this second-floor option for quiet study; the library notes it has no tables.
cards.short_summary: A quieter second-floor room when it is available.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern says students may study in the Prothro Room when it is not in use, and notes that it has no tables.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms and Spaces | Southwestern University
cards.access_notes: Second floor of Smith Library Center; availability depends on room use.

cards.title: Sandbox Media Lab
cards.subtitle: First floor, A. Frank Smith, Jr. Library Center
cards.notes: Use this named first-floor media-lab space for project work when a standard quiet-study room is not the right fit.
cards.short_summary: A named library media-lab space in the active zone.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern lists Sandbox Media Lab as a first-floor noisy, high-traffic space in Smith Library Center.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms and Spaces | Southwestern University
cards.access_notes: Located in Smith Library Center; follow current library access rules.

cards.title: Red & Charline McCombs Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Campus Center, Southwestern University
cards.notes: Meet up here for campus programming, dining, or mail needs. Southwestern documents that the center houses social functions, dining, and the post office.
cards.short_summary: A campus hub for shared events and everyday errands.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern’s historical campus tour says McCombs Campus Center houses social functions, the dining hall, and the post office.
cards.source_title: Homecoming 2017 Historic Campus Walking Tour | Southwestern University
cards.access_notes: Campus-center access and event availability vary; consult Southwestern for current details.

cards.title: Mabee Commons
cards.subtitle: Red & Charline McCombs Campus Center
cards.notes: Plan a meal or a conversation here; Southwestern identifies Mabee Commons as its main campus restaurant and says it serves the campus community.
cards.short_summary: The campus dining room within McCombs Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern describes Mabee Commons as the main restaurant destination on campus, serving students, faculty, staff, and the surrounding community during the academic year.
cards.source_title: Pirate Dining Earns Renovation of the Year Award | Southwestern University
cards.access_notes: Meals require a meal plan or payment; check Pirate Dining for current menus and hours.

cards.title: Greenhouse & Community Garden
cards.subtitle: Southwestern University campus
cards.notes: Walk over to see the campus garden and greenhouse together. The university’s virtual-tour gallery documents both as one named destination.
cards.short_summary: A campus growing space with a dedicated virtual-tour gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern’s virtual tour identifies the Greenhouse and Community Garden and includes images of both the garden and greenhouse.
cards.source_title: Greenhouse and Community Garden | Southwestern University
cards.access_notes: Use campus paths and observe any posted garden or greenhouse access guidance.

cards.title: Floyd & Annetta Jones Plaza
cards.subtitle: Southwestern University campus
cards.notes: Use this named plaza as an outdoor rendezvous point before campus events. Southwestern’s campus map lists it, and an inauguration reception was held here.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed campus plaza used for a university reception.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern’s campus map lists Floyd & Annetta Jones Plaza, and the university’s inauguration schedule located a reception there.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor availability may be affected by scheduled university events or weather.
